test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Machenical'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Mechanical'.**
 
• The word '**Mechanical**' is an **adjective** that means 'relating to machines or machinery'. **(यांत्रिक)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The car had a mechanical failure on the way to the city.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Machenical'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the correctly spelled words:**

 
• **Annual -** occurring once every year **(वार्षिक)**
 
• **Technical -** relating to a particular subject, art, or craft, or its techniques **(तकनीकी)**
 
• **Regulator -** a person or body that supervises a particular industry or business activity **(नियामक)**
